messages:
alex: saw a tiny 502 blip right after the canary deploy to eu-west-1 — anyone know the fastest obs pointers to grab traces/logs?
deploy-bot: deploy finished: canary/r1 @alex (image: inference:v3.2) :rocket:
maria: the quick set — ingress 502 heatmap dashboard, route-error-rate-by-tenant, and the proxy timeout panel. links: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ingress/502-heatmap , https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/routes/route-errors
jordan: start with a request-id sample from the ingress logs then open the trace in jaeger. look for upstream status and proxy_connect_timeout. if you paste a sample id i can pull the full span tree.
lee: Kibana query to hunt 502s briefly:
```
service: "ingress-proxy" AND status:502 AND @timestamp:[now-15m TO now]
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50
```
sam: also check the prefix-cache-timeout metric, we've seen small canaries trip kvcache latencies which cascade to 502s. metric: redwood.ingress.kv_cache.timeout.count by pod
maria: good call — check the kvcache histogram on the runtime dashboard too (https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/runtime/kv-cache). if it's spiking, the router will see short TTLs and drop to upstreams.
alex: i grabbed one sample: req-id=ab4c9f2e. jordan can you pull the trace? :eyes:
jordan: pulling now, link: https://jaeger.redwood/trace/ab4c9f2e (sharing for visibility). preliminary: 95th span shows connection timeout to upstream host inference-dedicated-12, then 502 returned by proxy.
lee: can you run this curl to fetch raw ingress log for that id?
```
curl -H "X-Request-Id: ab4c9f2e" "https://logs.redwood/api/search?q=ab4c9f2e" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OBS_KEY" | jq .hits.hits[0]._source
```
maria: alert tuning note — current 502 alert fires on 5m window with threshold 2%. for canary bursts i'd suggest temporarily raising to 3% or increasing evaluation window to 10m while we validate. paging @sam for input.
sam: +1 to longer eval window for canary stage, we get noisy transient blips. set to 10m/3% for canary routes only. ops-bot: runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/ingress-502-triage :spiral_notepad:
alex: thanks all — i'll collect the logs and paste a couple more req-ids, and propose a temporary alert tweak in the monitoring PR.
maria: if you see kvcache timeouts, tag @eng-runtime and we'll roll a quick config change to increase cache connection pool.
jordan: saved traces for ab4c9f2e and ab4c9f31 in the incident bucket. cc @lee if you want to pull spans.
alex: moving this to async, i'll update once i have 5 sample ids. :thumbsup:
